description: activitypub/inbox.rs handle_create() checks that the activity's actor is a registered follower of the target group before writing the note to IPFS. This prevents arbitrary remote actors from injecting content into the newsgroup via the AP inbox. The follower_store.is_follower() lookup is performed even when HTTP signature verification is disabled, providing a second layer of access control. The dedup logic (activity_id → note_id → SHA-256 of note) is also correctly ordered by specificity.
title: decision: handle_create follower-only injection guard prevents open content injection
